title: AI Pipeline Risk Detector
tagline: Spot stalled deals before they disappear.
businessOutcomes: Stalled deals get attention before they go cold.
summary: Detects deals at risk based on stage age, lack of activity, email response patterns, missing next steps, and forecast changes.
businessProblem: Deals silently stall — reps assume 'no news is good news' until the quarter ends. Managers discover at-risk pipeline only when it's too late to recover.
outcome: Daily or weekly risk-ranked deal list with specific risk factors, suggested recovery actions, and forecast impact — so reps intervene before deals go cold.
expectedOutcomes: Daily or weekly risk-ranked deal list with specific risk factors, suggested recovery actions, and forecast impact — so reps intervene before deals go cold.
whoItsFor: Sales managers and reps managing 10–50 active opportunities who need early warning on stall patterns without manual pipeline reviews.
aiInputs: Deal stage, amount, close date, and days in current stage
Activity timeline: last email, call, meeting date
Email sentiment and response latency patterns
Presence of next step and scheduled follow-up in CRM
Proposal sent date and response status if applicable
aiOutputs: Risk score per deal (0–100) with factor breakdown
Risk tier: Critical / At Risk / Watch / Healthy
Specific stall signals cited with dates
Suggested recovery action per deal (call, exec sponsor, revised proposal)
Manager rollup: total pipeline at risk by rep and stage
noCodeTools: HubSpot deal pipeline reports with custom risk properties
Zapier: stale deal trigger → GPT risk summary → Slack alert
lowCodeTools: n8n daily: CRM deals → activity check → OpenAI risk narrative → Slack
Google Sheets pipeline export + Apps Script risk scoring
Make.com: Salesforce opportunity update → risk recalc → email manager
customBuildStack: CRM deal sync with activity aggregation
Rule-based risk factors + AI qualitative email/thread analysis
Gmail/Outlook API for response pattern detection
Slack alerts for Critical tier deals
Manager dashboard with risk trend over time
implementationSteps: Define risk factors and weights: stage age, activity gap, no next step, ghosted emails
Connect CRM and email APIs for activity and thread analysis
Build baseline rule score; add AI layer for email tone and engagement signals
Deliver daily Slack digest to reps; weekly rollup to managers
Track recovery rate: deals flagged at risk that moved forward vs. lost
Tune thresholds quarterly based on your average sales cycle length
systemBehavior: Runs daily on full active pipeline — not per-email real-time
Read-only on email; writes risk score fields to CRM
Does not auto-change deal stages or close dates
Escalates Critical deals to manager channel after 48h no rep action
Logs risk score history to show improvement or deterioration
risks: False positives on slow enterprise deals create alert fatigue
Email sentiment analysis misreads short replies as disengagement
Risk scores without rep context blame wrong factors
Over-monitoring damages rep trust if used punitively
